bio_en: Khnko was born in 1884 in Bashgarni in the Erivan governorate into a very modest family and never went to school, learning a little reading and writing during the Armenian-Tatar clashes. Trained by Ghazar Kocharyan, he took part in the Mosun and Zor expedition of 1904, and in 1905 fought with the bands in Goghtn, carrying out a party-ordered execution. He served in the Russian army in 1906-09 and was sent to the German front in 1914, then fought in all the battles of the Republic of Armenia. He died in exile in a car accident, lamenting that a fedayi should end his life that way rather than on the battlefield.
